facts.fact: 穿凉鞋的法国人叫 Phillipe Floppe——flip-flop（人字拖）
facts.anchor: What do you call a Frenchman in sandals? Phillipe Floppe.

facts.fact: 俄罗斯套娃很自信：里面装满自己（full of themselves＝自负／装满自己）
facts.anchor: Russian dolls are overconfident. They’re so full of themselves.

facts.fact: 瑞士最好的地方：国旗上一个大十字（plus＝加号／优点）
facts.anchor: What’s the best thing about Switzerland? Well, the flag’s a big plus.

facts.fact: 飞机上与占座的人争执，最后对方起身说“行，你开飞机吧”——他其实是飞行员
facts.anchor: Eventually he stood up and said, ‘Fine, you fly the plane!’

facts.fact: 想让朋友玩从北方开始圈加拿大领地的游戏，她说没兴趣：Nunavut 谐音 none of it
在克罗地亚第二大城吃香蕉冰淇淋，对方问“Split？”（城名），答“不，就是普通香蕉冰淇淋”
在密歇根湖附近见到自己的分身，对方说“Eerie”（伊利湖），答“不，绝对是密歇根”
facts.anchor: ‘I saw my doppelganger once, near Lake Michigan.’ ‘Eerie.’ ‘No, it was definitely Michigan.’

facts.fact: 以前从路易斯安那买洗衣粉，现在改用 non-bayou（不含河口沼泽）／non-buy?
facts.anchor: I used to buy my washing powder from Louisiana, but recently I’ve switched to non-bayou.

facts.fact: 在俄罗斯餐巾厂工作，加入了 serviette union——谐音 Soviet Union
facts.anchor: I used to work in a napkin factory in Russia. I was in the serviette union.

facts.fact: 罗马尼亚晚上不能看书：该让 Bucharest（书休息）——book a rest
facts.anchor: Why can’t you read at night in Romania? It’s time to give the Bucharest.
